description: Streets Dataset is a dataset listed in Malta Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office of the Address Registrar. Streets Dataset which shall hold records of all streets which are publicly or privately-owned and which serve as thoroughfares or any other type of passageway and which are assigned a name by the Registrar. Coverage: Office of the Address Registrar. The publisher named on the listing is Office of the Address Registrar. Its keywords include road, address. The listing shows 1 download or service links in API. The listing shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-mt.
